chapterPurpose: ‘Our School — A Happy Place’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects safe and inclusive school spaces, plants and animals around school, roles in a school community, care and responsibility, mapping familiar spaces. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.
